in_marathi.name: Kuljeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuljeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kul’ (crown) and ‘jit’ (victory). The name Kuljeet represents a victorious king or leader, one who wears the crown of success.
